name: VoiceStudio
description: VoiceStudio is the open-source, fully-local ElevenLabs alternative — voice cloning, voice design, video dubbing, dictation, transcription & audiobook creation in 646 languages.
one_liner: A free desktop app that clones or invents voices, dubs videos into other languages, and turns text into narrated audio — all running on your own computer, no cloud subscription.
buyer: A solo YouTuber or course creator who wants to dub videos into multiple languages or produce audiobooks without paying per-minute fees to a service like ElevenLabs.
business_use_cases: A YouTuber dubs their back catalog into Spanish and Hindi to unlock new-language ad revenue without hiring voice actors.
A course creator turns a written curriculum into a narrated audiobook overnight using a cloned or designed voice, instead of booking studio time.
A local audiobook publisher offers cheap 'AI-narrated in 48 hours' service to small self-published authors who can't afford professional narration.

money_ideas.idea: A done-for-you 'dub your channel into 5 languages' service for YouTubers, billed per video.
A subscription studio that batch-produces audiobooks for indie authors using the tool's engines.
White-label the local install as a privacy-first voice tool for agencies that can't send client audio to the cloud.

steal_this: Pick 10 popular but under-dubbed YouTube tutorials, dub them into 2-3 languages this weekend with VoiceStudio, and pitch the channel owners a rev-share on the new-language views.
